<!--
  A prompt box on a dark band: attachment chips, the prompt line, a plus button, the model pill and a send
  button. Static links only; a host adds behavior.
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type PromptComposerProps = {
  label?: string;
  attachLabel?: string;
  modelLabel?: string;
  send?: string;
  href?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const { label, attachLabel, modelLabel, send, href } = defineProps<PromptComposerProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Box
    :class="cn(
      'mx-auto flex w-full flex-col gap-4 bg-background/10 p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-background/30',
      defaults.hero.composer
    )"
    data-testid="email-form"
  >
    <Group v-if="attachLabel" gap="2" align="center" data-testid="composer-attachments">
      <Button
        href="#/"
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        :class="cn(
          'gap-2 overflow-hidden bg-background/10 text-background hover:bg-background/20',
          defaults.hero.attach
        )"
        data-testid="composer-attach"
      >
        <LucideIcon name="file-text" :size="16" />
        {{ attachLabel }}
      </Button>
      <Button
        href="#/"
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        :class="cn(
          'gap-2 overflow-hidden bg-background/10 text-background hover:bg-background/20',
          defaults.hero.attach
        )"
        data-testid="composer-attach"
      >
        <LucideIcon name="paperclip" :size="16" />
        {{ attachLabel }}
      </Button>
    </Group>
    <Text
      size="xs"
      weight="semibold"
      :class="cn('flex w-full items-center leading-5 text-background/80', defaults.hero.promptLine)"
      data-testid="field"
    >
      {{ label }}
    </Text>
    <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between" class="h-8 w-full" data-testid="composer-tools">
      <Group gap="2" align="center">
        <Button
          href="#/"
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          layout="icon"
          class="bg-background/10 text-background hover:bg-background/20"
          data-testid="composer-plus"
          :aria-label="(attachLabel ?? 'Attach')"
        >
          <LucideIcon name="plus" :size="16" />
        </Button>
        <Button v-if="modelLabel"
          href="#/"
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          :class="cn('gap-2 bg-background/10 text-background hover:bg-background/20', defaults.hero.model)"
          data-testid="composer-model"
        >
          <LucideIcon name="sparkles" :size="16" />
          {{ modelLabel }}
          <LucideIcon name="chevron-down" :size="16" />
        </Button>
      </Group>
      <Button
        :href="(href ?? '#/')"
        variant="secondary"
        size="sm"
        layout="icon"
        data-testid="submit"
        :aria-label="(send ?? 'Send')"
      >
        <LucideIcon name="arrow-up" :size="16" />
      </Button>
    </Group>
  </Box>
</template>
